research.title: Image Classification Under Illumination Variation
bullets: Implemented assigned preprocessing and evaluation routines for a histogram of oriented gradients classifier using a specified illumination perturbation protocol.
Checked feature extraction consistency and summarized classification errors across lighting conditions for review with the research team.

work.title: Image Ingestion and Validation Services
bullets: Maintained image ingestion components that checked file readability, normalized metadata, and routed malformed uploads for operational review.
Investigated processing failures, added regression tests for supported image formats, and documented error handling behavior for routine maintenance.

projects.title: Color Histogram Baseline for Scene Classification
bullets: Implemented a scene classification baseline using normalized color histograms and a nearest neighbor classifier with predefined training and test partitions.
Compared histogram binning choices on validation data and inspected confusion matrices to identify errors among visually similar scene categories.
